key_insight: SURGENT is a multi-agent assistance system designed to enhance surgical workflows by improving decision-making and reasoning through comprehensive patient data integration.
clinical_relevance: This system addresses critical limitations of existing surgical applications of large language models, ultimately aiming to improve surgical outcomes.
method: Combines Tree-of-Thought planner with multi-department collaboration agents.
Uses retrieval-augmented reasoning aligned with clinical guidelines.
Manages both long-term patient histories and short-term summaries.
evidence_signal: Experimental evaluations indicate SURGENT outperforms baseline LLMs and existing frameworks in key perioperative tasks.
watch_item: Implementation may require careful handling of privacy and security in healthcare settings.
paper_title: SURGENT: A Surgical Multi-Agent Assistance System Across the Perioperative Workflow
